title: June 2026 Release Wave - Copilot Enhancements
description: GitHub released multiple Copilot updates in early June 2026, including larger context windows with configurable reasoning levels, Copilot Chat improvements for pull requests, and the general availability of Enterprise Teams. Additional updates include agent tasks REST API for Copilot Pro tiers, budget and usage management APIs, and billing usage reports API.

title: GPT-5.2 and GPT-5.2-Codex Models Deprecated
description: GitHub deprecated GPT-5.2 and GPT-5.2-Codex models for Copilot users as part of the June 2026 update cycle.

title: Copilot SDK Generally Available
description: The Copilot SDK became generally available in June 2026, providing developers with programmatic access to Copilot capabilities.

title: Visual Studio and VS Code May/June Updates
description: GitHub released Copilot updates for Visual Studio (May update) and Visual Studio Code with Copilot Chat bringing richer context to pull requests.

title: Fix with Copilot for Failing Actions
description: New 'Fix with Copilot' feature for failing GitHub Actions is now available in Copilot Pro, Pro+, and Max tiers, allowing AI-assisted debugging of workflow failures.
